note: Which model fills `harm` for each area. Set by the shipping rule in docs/PREREGISTRATION.md as first written (the curve if it passes C0, C1, C1b, C2, C3 and C8; otherwise the hard floor if it passes C0 to C3; otherwise the ratio), applied to the models with one constant per calendar month (docs/DECISIONS.md, decision 57, 15 Nov 2026). Until then the year-round-constant models shipped under the revised check C3r (decision 30). C3r and the year-round versions' verdicts stay published in meta.json.

cordoba.reason: Hard floor, with one constant per calendar month. Passes every check the shipping rule names, as first written: C0, C1 (0.077), C1b, C2 (-0.094) and C3 (0.117 against 0.15); also C3r, C3x (2020 to 2021: 0.124) and C4. The detection curve passes C3 (0.072) but fails the 2016 placebo C2 (-0.114 against 0.10), so the rule moves to the hard floor. Until 15 Nov the detection curve with one year-round constant shipped under the revised check C3r; it failed C3 (0.207) because its error followed the season.

punjab-haryana.reason: Hard floor, with one constant per calendar month. Passes every check the shipping rule names, as first written: C0, C1 (-0.020), C1b, C2 (-0.059) and C3 (0.148 against 0.15, narrowly); also C3r and C4. Fails C3x, added after results: the same statistic on 2020 to 2021 is 0.169. The detection curve fails C3 (0.208) and C8 (its midpoint is too uncertain), which is why it does not ship. Until 15 Nov the hard floor with one year-round constant shipped; it failed C3 (0.169) because its error followed the season.

chilecito.reason: Case-study area with too few fires to calibrate. Uses Cordoba's curve, floor and monthly constants, and Cordoba's model (the hard floor). Its own checks are shown and several fail because so few fires occur there.

karnataka-south.reason: Shipping rule: no model passes the held-out checks here (C3 and C3r: in 2018-2019 Aqua saw 16 to 21 percent more than any harmonized version), so the conversion-ratio fallback ships, with one constant per calendar month. The detection curve passes C0, C1, C1b, C2, C4 and C8; the fallback fails C2 (-0.119), C3 (0.288) and C3r (-0.196). Region added after the start (decision 36); not pre-registered.
